slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 6m to GBP 598m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 6m to GBP 598m
Total reserve: GBP 598m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 6m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,566.1m
The principal increases were Casualty +GBP 4m and Property +GBP 1m.
No projection-method selections changed this quarter.
Selected Casualty assumptions have begun to respond to emerging experience; the overall movement remains manageable.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Casualty: strengthened GBP 4m. Deterioration in accident years 2022 to 2024 is increasingly visible; assumptions are responding.
Property: strengthened GBP 1m. Experience is within expectation; catastrophe exposure is monitored seasonally.
Motor: strengthened GBP 1m. Frequency and severity trends remain within expectation.
Marine: broadly flat in the quarter.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Selected Casualty loss ratios and the inflation assumption have been raised in response to emerging experience; further adverse emergence would require additional strengthening.
Large loss activity in Property is marginally elevated and is being monitored ahead of the windstorm season.
Premium growth assumptions for the current accident year remain on plan.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
Casualty assumptions have been updated in response to emerging experience. The overall reserve movement remains manageable.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 598m
